## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete change and affected benchmark identifiers.

## Definition and provenance

Link the original source and state the selected version, bounds, directions,
constraint signs/scales, and any differences from a reference implementation.

## Validation

- [ ] Analytical/reference checks cover the changed formulas.
- [ ] Single, batch, boundary and invalid-input behavior is checked where relevant.
- [ ] `pytest`, Ruff and `scripts/build_catalog.py --check` pass.
- [ ] Catalogue status, formulas and changelog match the final implementation.
- [ ] Any reused code or data is correctly attributed and licensed.
